verdict.rationale: Square maintains a dedicated 'connect-api-specification' GitHub repository (referenced in square-docs-19) which is the canonical OpenAPI spec for its Connect APIs, and it also exposes a machine-readable llms.txt index (square-probe-1). However, direct download endpoints on the developer docs site (openapi.json, swagger.json, docs.md) all return 404 (square-probe-2, square-probe-3), so there's no single obvious in-docs download link — users must know to find the separate GitHub repo. Missing for 10: a first-party linked/downloadable OpenAPI file directly from developer.squareup.com, and independent confirmation the GitHub spec is kept fully in sync with current APIs.
